source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade FPGA firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade FPGA firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + FPGA image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek proposes browser-driven FPGA upload/start/wait with the host off, followed by the source-required AC cycle and FPGA version check.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: WebUI screenshots/status and pre/post FPGA version, plus an unsupported clean-single-reset phrase.
deepseek_columns.risk: DeepSeek identifies the FPGA-write, interruption and mandatory AC-cycle hazards.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves the FPGA target, WebUI path and AC activation, but substitutes unqualified browser automation and conflates the explicit AC cycle with a clean single reset.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; strong component, power and recovery controls, but project-supplied images and AC parameters are readiness rather than a permanent semantic block.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 728/2291 retains the host-off FPGA WebUI and AC-cycle flow.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: The non-atomic sequence-897 draft was inspected only as history and was not used as proof of review.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-25 keeps WebUI operation engineer-owned; ED-36 treats project images/power values as readiness; ED-38 reserves the DUT verdict; the approved target rule requires retaining FPGA exactly.

original_test_intent: Have an engineer upgrade and downgrade the identified FPGA through the BMC WebUI while the host starts off, then perform the explicitly required AC cycle and prove the selected FPGA image activates without BMC or host recovery failure.
original_method: The Master method is an attended WebUI firmware write followed by an AC power cycle. The linked raw-IPMI repository is at most an independent version read and must be proven to address this exact FPGA field; it does not replace the WebUI or power-transition coverage.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer selects and confirms each FPGA image in the BMC WebUI, observes terminal flash status, and controls or authorizes the physical/managed AC-cycle hand-off. The agent may prepare and analyze evidence but does not operate the WebUI or power cycle.
required_inputs: exact FPGA component/board revision and current/upgrade/downgrade versions
signed images with hashes and supported direction/order
vendor WebUI programming and post-flash AC-activation procedure
approved AC controller, off/on dwell, count and management-recovery timing
authoritative FPGA readback plus BMC/host health and recovery criteria
safety_requirements: Retain FPGA as the target and bind the image to its exact device and board revision; never substitute CPLD or another programmable component.
Do not begin the AC cycle until the WebUI reports a terminal flash state and the vendor-defined safe-to-remove-power condition is met.
Distinguish initial host-off with BMC standby from the later full AC removal; verify users/jobs and independent recovery before the power action.
Do not infer that browser completion or a raw version string proves activation; verify the exact FPGA after AC restoration and the full BMC/host lifecycle.
On ambiguity or failure, preserve WebUI, power, console and SEL evidence and never repeat the flash or AC cycle automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Organize component/image identity, capture read-only FPGA/BMC/host baselines and monitor approved power telemetry.
After engineer actions, collect authoritative FPGA readback, BMC reachability, SEL, console POST and OS health without assigning the verdict.
Validate the linked raw-IPMI command and field mapping before accepting its output as this FPGA's version.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform both WebUI version directions and the exact AC-cycle method/timing.
Confirm post-AC FPGA activation and platform recovery, then issue direction-specific verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves FPGA, host-off and AC activation, but browser automation cannot take over the ED-25 WebUI boundary and clean-single-reset is not the source criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor BMC WebUI manually, then execute the project-approved AC-cycle SOP and verify the exact FPGA through an authoritative readback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FPGA target, WebUI method, initial host-off state, mandatory AC cycle, linked script and 5/30-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED FPGA WEBUI UPDATE WITH CONTROLLED AC ACTIVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind one signed image to the exact FPGA, capture engineer-owned WebUI terminal status, execute the approved AC cycle only after safe-to-remove-power, and verify FPGA activation plus BMC/host POST/OS health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact FPGA/BMC platform whose vendor procedure requires AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record FPGA/board image, BMC/WebUI/browser, readback decoder and AC-controller revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor FPGA programming/AC-activation/recovery documentation and project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component identity, safe-to-cycle gate, power telemetry, authoritative readback and recovery checkpoints without replacing the WebUI method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An approved alternate updater may prove a project FPGA transition but cannot claim the source WebUI path; a post-AC version alone does not prove all platform health.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved FPGA transition and AC-cycle contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power removal before programming reaches its vendor terminal state can leave programmable logic or platform management unrecoverable.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define another approved update tool and the AC mechanism, but must retain the original WebUI method, actual tool, reason, approval, equivalent checkpoints and remaining WebUI coverage. The target remains FPGA and may not be silently rewritten as CPLD.
expected_evidence: approved FPGA/board/version/image matrix with signatures and hashes
engineer-owned WebUI selection, confirmation, progress and terminal-state evidence
vendor safe-to-remove-power indication plus AC-controller timeline, dwell and telemetry
post-AC exact FPGA version/identity, BMC reachability, SEL, console POST and OS health
recovery readiness and engineer verdict for each direction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target FPGA through WebUI with a required post-flash AC cycle. Exact images, component revision and AC timing are project inputs; DeepSeek's clean-single-reset wording is not imported.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The FPGA target, WebUI operation and AC-activation lifecycle are clear. Missing project artifacts and power values are named readiness inputs, so MANUAL ONLY—not permanent BLOCKED—captures the engineer-owned interface and power action.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes PARTIAL to MANUAL ONLY, retains FPGA/host-off/AC risks, and rejects unapproved browser ownership plus reset conflation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps component, power and recovery safeguards while removing permanent BLOCKED because the project can supply exact values.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the FPGA-specific WebUI/AC boundary without relying on the invalid record's conclusion.

review_improvement: Creates separate gates for WebUI terminal completion, safe AC removal, exact FPGA activation and full platform recovery while preserving the source target and method.
independent_technical_reasoning: The explicit AC cycle is an activation step, not a generic reset, and must occur only after the FPGA writer reaches a vendor-defined terminal state. Because both WebUI acceptance and power control remain engineer-owned, the complete case is MANUAL ONLY. The missing image and timing values are resolvable Project SPEC inputs, so the review is not BLOCKED.
